name: Bacterial Pathogenesis
description: Bacterial ultrastructure; pathogens, commensals and opportunistic bacteria; adhesion, invasion and transmission; bacterial virulence factors; biofilms; bacterial protein secretion systems; gene regulation and mobile genetic elements; pathogenicity islands; quorum sensing; interaction with host cells; receptor binding, entry and endosomal escape; cellular survival; immune system and antibacterial defense; bacterial countermeasures; diagnosis and treatment; antibiotics and mechanisms of resistance; vaccination strategies; adaptation and emergence of new pathogens.
